日期、时间与时区始终采用 Windows 当前值。使用系统定位时，每次启动读取系:
Windows date, time and time zone are always used. In system-location mode, startup reads Windows location and applies it when available; otherwise, saved coordinates remain.

Solar events are estimated locally. Windows location may use the network or cached data. The app checks every 15 seconds and realigns after resume, unlock or an engine restart. Closing the window keeps it in the tray; use the tray menu to quit.
关闭登录启动选项并保存，从托盘彻底退出，然后在 Wallpaper Engine:
Turn off sign-in startup and save, then quit from the tray. Restore your original playlist in Wallpaper Engine. Remove the portable folder to uninstall a portable copy.

settings.xml stores settings; .bak is the previous backup; activity.log records operations. Coordinates stay on this PC. Installed mode uses the user data folder; portable mode uses data. The app does not change the Windows clock or location permissions.
